tasks.label: Makolo — Démarrer émulateur Android
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $id = 'emulator-5554'; $devices = @(adb devices); $found = @($devices | Where-Object { $_ -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '\s+') }).Count -gt 0; if (-not $found) { flutter emulators --launch Makolo_API_35; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Impossible de lancer l emulateur Makolo_API_35.' } }; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120; $i++) {;   $state = (adb -s $id get-state 2>$null | Out-String).Trim();   if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $state -eq 'device') {;     $boot = (adb -s $id shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>$null | Out-String).Trim();     if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $boot -eq '1') { $ready = $true; break };   };   Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; }; if (-not $ready) { throw 'Emulateur non pret. Verifiez Android Device Manager et adb devices.' }; Write-Host 'Makolo : emulateur Android pret'
